sentiment.rationale: The company exceeded its own fourth quarter guidance with double-digit bookings and revenue growth, and provided strong first quarter 2026 guidance of 10-12% bookings growth and 11-13% revenue growth, which implies stability at the upper end. However, the full-year 2026 guidance of 6-8% bookings growth and 6-9% revenue growth represents a deceleration from the 8% full-year 2025 growth, and management explicitly flagged 'ongoing macro uncertainty' and a 'more cautious view' at the lower end of the range. The strong Q1 guidance and margin expansion expectations (3-4 points) indicate genuine operational momentum, but the tempered full-year outlook and explicit caution prevent a higher score.

summary.revenue: Q4 2025 revenue was $3,547 million, up 11% year-over-year. Full year 2025 revenue was $14,733 million, up 8% year-over-year.
summary.eps: Q4 2025 GAAP diluted EPS was $1.60, down 27% year-over-year. Adjusted EPS was $3.78, up 58% year-over-year. Full year 2025 GAAP diluted EPS was $9.81, up 10% year-over-year. Adjusted EPS was $15.86, up 31% year-over-year.
summary.guidance: Q1 2026: Gross bookings $34.6-$35.2B (+10-12% y/y), Revenue $3.32-$3.37B (+11-13% y/y), Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion +3-4 points. Full Year 2026: Gross bookings $127-$129B (+6-8% y/y), Revenue $15.6-$16.0B (+6-9% y/y), Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion +1-1.25 points.
summary.margin: Q4 2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin was 23.9%, expanding 368 basis points year-over-year. Full year 2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin was 23.8%, up from 21.4% in 2024.
key_risks: Ongoing macro uncertainty and dynamic macro environment
Geopolitical issues in Asia weighing on rest of world growth
Intense competition from online travel agencies, suppliers, search engines, and emerging AI-powered platforms
Declines or disruptions in the travel industry due to economic conditions, geopolitical events, or public health issues
Dependence on relationships with travel suppliers and other B2B partners
Dependence on search engines and changes to search algorithms or traffic acquisition costs
Foreign exchange exposure and counterparty risks
Technology system failures, cybersecurity breaches, and data protection compliance
key_opportunities: B2B gross bookings grew 24% in Q4, with continued double-digit growth across all regions
Advertising revenue grew 19% in Q4, with a record number of active partners
AI initiatives driving product improvements, faster site performance (30% faster), and operational efficiencies
Lodging property count grew by more than 10% in Q4 compared to 2024
International growth, with room nights growing faster outside the US than in the US
Direct bookings growing faster than bookings from indirect channels
Expansion of VrboCare and new product offerings like Cancel for Any Reason assurance product
Tiqets acquisition to broaden activities offered to B2B partners
